clue.text: HM's autobiography, perhaps, in single instalments

definitions.meaning: the Queen speaks of herself as 'one', so a book written by her would be 'by one'

explanation.surface: A royal memoir is being published as a serial, a part at a time.
explanation.walkthrough: HM is Her Majesty; the royal 'one' is how the monarch famously refers to herself.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for doing things singly, each in turn.

clue.text: Compensate for bad tennis games

parts.note: food that has gone bad is off
a set is a group of games in tennis

explanation.surface: Someone makes up for a poor showing on the tennis court.
explanation.definitionFit: To counterbalance or cancel out something is a synonym of making up for it.

clue.text: Most of what Lenin preached is explained by Darwin

indicators.note: almost all of the word is kept here, with one letter dropped from its front

parts.note: Lenin preached Communist revolution

explanation.surface: A contrast between Lenin's doctrine and Darwin's theory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Most of' here drops the first letter, R, rather than the usual last one.
explanation.definitionFit: Darwin's theory of natural selection set out how species change over generations.

clue.text: Kind of culture coming from an unknown direction

parts.note: y is an algebraic unknown
east is a compass direction

explanation.surface: A culture arriving from some mysterious quarter of the world.
explanation.definitionFit: Bakers and brewers keep a live culture of this fungus to raise dough or ferment beer.

clue.text: Name on bags of pasta

parts.note: bags of something means lots, plenty

explanation.surface: A label printed on packets of pasta.
explanation.definitionFit: Long thin strips of dough are a kind of pasta, here the general category.

clue.text: One of 13 would be relevant without English

indicators.note: signals that a letter is dropped from the word for relevant

parts.note: germane means relevant, pertinent

explanation.surface: A cryptic remark about relevance once something English is removed.
explanation.walkthrough: 13 across is LANGUAGES, so the definition asks for a single tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: The tongue spoken in Berlin and Vienna is one example of the cross-referenced category.

clue.text: Having nothing in reserve, he used tax reforms

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase are formed again in a new order

explanation.surface: A man has spent all his savings after a change in the tax rules.
explanation.definitionFit: Being completely drained or used up means having no reserves left.

clue.text: Criminal boss, a real heavyweight?

definitions.meaning: slang for the head of a gang or crime syndicate
read literally, a gentleman who is very large

explanation.definitionFit: Underworld slang for the top man of a gang, and literally a big mister.

clue.text: Prototype wildlife refuge

parts.note: the Biblical vessel that saved two of every animal from the Flood was the first animal sanctuary

explanation.definitionFit: The Genesis boat sheltering pairs of every creature is jokingly the original animal sanctuary.

clue.text: Where travelling may get you, literally

definitions.text: Where travelling may get you, literally

parts.words: Where travelling may get you, literally
parts.note: travel takes you between places, and read literally through the alphabet it moves from the first letter to the second

explanation.definitionFit: A stock phrase for a journey between two points, and also the step between the first two letters.

clue.text: Type of 29 that gives you the jitters, irrationally

definitions.meaning: 29 across is NEUROSIS; an irrational dread is one kind

definitions.text: that gives you the jitters, irrationally
definitions.meaning: an unreasoning fear of something that makes one nervous

explanation.definitionFit: An irrational fear is a recognised kind of anxiety disorder, which makes a person nervous.

clue.text: It can pile up in banks nowadays

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words that follow, across the gap between them

explanation.surface: Something accumulating in financial institutions these days, like money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banks' suggests money, but the answer is the white stuff that drifts into banks.
explanation.definitionFit: Falling flakes accumulate into drifts, which is what this weather does.

clue.text: Left gutted after vote splits EU — rejoice!

indicators.note: the gutted word comes after the other pieces
the vote letter cuts the two letters of EU apart

parts.note: a cross, X, marks a vote on a ballot

indicators.note: with its insides removed, leaving only the outer letters

explanation.surface: A Remainer's or Leaver's cheer after a vote divides Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: To exult is to celebrate triumphantly, an imperative synonym of being glad.

clue.text: Centuries after North Gaul collapsed some Latin descendants appear

indicators.note: the letters fall into ruin and are rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: ages means long periods, centuries

explanation.surface: After Roman Gaul fell, new tongues gradually emerged from Latin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collapsed' rearranges NGAUL into LANGU; 'after' in the surface is just the order of the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: French, Spanish, Italian and the other Romance tongues all descend from Latin.

clue.text: Various ducks, for instance

definitions.meaning: an old word meaning sundry, several
birds that dive under water, or anything that dives

explanation.definitionFit: An archaic adjective for sundry, and a plural noun for things that plunge underwater.

clue.text: Ways to pay off debt popular with students

definitions.meaning: undemanding academic terms would please students

explanation.definitionFit: Gentle repayment arrangements, and literally undemanding stretches of the school year.

clue.text: Drink keeping cold (and hot!) for the guard

indicators.note: the drink holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: water is something to drink
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
H is the abbreviation for hot on taps

explanation.surface: Someone on sentry duty is given a drink that can be served cold or hot.
explanation.definitionFit: A lookout or sentinel keeps watch, so a guard is one who observes.

clue.text: Tough players on the team's books

parts.note: hard means tough
backs are defensive players in football or rugby

explanation.surface: Hard men in a sports team are registered on its books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the books' sounds like a squad list; here books is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Volumes bound in stiff covers are a category of books.

clue.text: Following wild party in Paris we end up starving

indicators.note: the French word comes after the party word

parts.note: a rave is a wild party
nous is French for we

explanation.surface: After a night of partying in Paris, we finish up famished.
explanation.definitionFit: Extremely hungry is a synonym of famished.

clue.text: It affects lotus-eaters and strange men in Asia

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters are put into an odd order

explanation.surface: Something afflicting the mythical lotus-eaters and odd men in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Odyssey, eating the lotus made Odysseus's men forget home.
explanation.definitionFit: Memory loss is what the lotus fruit caused in Homer's legend.

clue.text: They used to record blood groups

definitions.meaning: the Swedish pop group that made records in the 1970s

explanation.definitionFit: The Swedish pop quartet recorded hits, and the name is spelt with blood-type letters.

clue.text: It's filthy or horribly rude

indicators.note: the letters are horribly mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A judgement that something is either dirty or offensive.
explanation.definitionFit: Dung or excrement is filth, something foul.

clue.text: Prompt to welcome Eton's first-former

indicators.note: the punctual phrase takes in the letter as a guest

parts.note: on time means prompt, punctual

indicators.note: the initial letter of the school's name

explanation.walkthrough: 'first-former' looks like a pupil but splits into an indicator and the definition. Eton is an English boarding school.

clue.text: Doctor approaches couple in 1 across as possible spies

parts.note: 1 across has two of the word for single unit in it, so a pair of those

explanation.surface: A doctor sidles up to a pair from the first clue, perhaps as spies.
explanation.definitionFit: Unmanned aircraft are often used for surveillance.

clue.text: Likely to be chosen, being tasty without a starter

parts.note: delectable means delicious, tasty

explanation.surface: A dish deemed likely to be picked because it is tasty, even without an appetiser.

clue.text: She's not completely above the law

indicators.note: only part of the phrase is used, its ends cut away

explanation.surface: A woman who is only partly exempt from legal rules.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's first name stands for any she.

clue.text: Shoot down revolutionary for King Edward?

indicators.note: turning round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: to rebut is to refute, shoot down an argument

explanation.surface: A rebel downs a monarch named Edward.

explanation.definitionFit: The potato variety is an example of a swollen underground stem.

clue.text: Poll tax rebel also takes part in 16

definitions.meaning: Wat ... led the Peasants' Revolt of 1381 against the poll tax
his first name, Wat, forms part of 16 across

explanation.definitionFit: The leader of the 1381 rising against the poll tax, whose first name appears in WATCHER.

clue.text: Hero in disguise could be rented out

indicators.note: the letters are dressed up in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A disguised hero may be hired out like a costume.
explanation.definitionFit: Available to hire is the same as being let or leased out.

clue.text: William's able to boil water in it

can means is able

explanation.surface: William can boil water inside something.

clue.text: Special military punishment 14 created

parts.note: the lash, flogging, was a military punishment

explanation.surface: A harsh punishment devised for the military.

clue.text: New money is a possible cause of depression

parts.note: euros are money

explanation.surface: Sudden wealth might make someone depressed.
explanation.definitionFit: An anxiety disorder is a mental condition that can lead to low moods.
